detailed_descriptions_html.en:
WELCOME TO THE COMPANY, CREW MEMBER... READY TO PURGE SOME ANOMALIES?

In Anomaly Company you and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Set in realistic, liminal environments, you must memorize your surroundings and spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

ARE YOU PREPARED TO CONTAIN THE ANOMALOUS TIMELINES?

GAMEPLAY

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-Op
    Play solo or with up to 4 players online in a cooperative horror experience. Communicate using voice chat or text chat to analyze environments, share observations, and argue over whether an anomaly is present.

  • Your Job as a Crew member
    Each level begins in a stable state. Memorize the environment, then watch closely as subtle changes, disturbing anomalies, and terrifying events may occur. Decide whether the timeline is safe or must be purged to progress.

A SOLO DEV PROJECT

I’m a solo developer working on Anomaly Company entirely by myself. Every feature, update, and fix is made by me. Because of this, development can be slower than that of a typical game studio—but it also means the game is built with care, passion, and close attention to player feedback.

THINGS YOU CAN DO IN ANOMALY COMPANY

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-Op

  • Co-Op Horror Gameplay

  • High Replayability

  • Voice Chat & Text Chat

  • Realistic & Liminal Environments

  • Disturbing Anomalies & Jumpscares

  • Observation-Based Gameplay

  • Unique maps, each with a unique setting and loads of anomalies

ENTER A WORLD THAT FEELS UNCOMFORTABLY REAL

EXPERIENCE THE TERRORS OF THE ASYLUM, WHILE YOU UNRAVEL ITS INSANITY

FACE ABSURD ANOMALIES, CHAOS, AND UNPREDICTABLE HORRORS

FOLLOW PROTOCOL. TRUST YOUR CREW. MAKE THE COMPANY PROUD.

You work for the Anomaly Company.

Trust your memory. Question reality.
